criteria.description: Primary shell and disclosure reach every documented state: desktop hover/click open-close, keyboard Enter/Space, Escape with focus return, outside/destination/mobile/breakpoint close, mobile activation-only panel

Exactly one brand, four top entries (3 plain + 1 disclosure), three title-only destinations, two actions inside the collapsible panel, one named toggle, one chevron — no duplicates or invented rich chrome
Desktop floating logo-left / menu-right / actions row; mobile top row logo+toggle only with links and stacked full-width actions below when open
Codex reviewed fresh desktop and mobile captures against the reference brief
